# pulse-infragraph

> Open-source Attack Surface Management tool for passive subdomain discovery, HTTP fingerprinting, risk scoring, and graph storage.

pulse-infragraph is a Python-based ASM tool for authorized security teams. It discovers subdomains via certificate transparency, fingerprints HTTP services, scores risk heuristically, and exports JSON, CSV, TXT, SARIF, and PDF reports. MIT licensed.

## Quick Start

- [README](https://github.com/mrcyberharsh/pulse-infragraph/blob/main/README.md): Installation, CLI, Streamlit dashboard
- [Contributing](https://github.com/mrcyberharsh/pulse-infragraph/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Development workflow
- [Security Policy](https://github.com/mrcyberharsh/pulse-infragraph/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Responsible disclosure
- [Support](https://github.com/mrcyberharsh/pulse-infragraph/blob/main/SUPPORT.md): Getting help

## Core Documentation

- [Risk Model](https://github.com/mrcyberharsh/pulse-infragraph#risk-model): SAFE / EXPOSED / CRITICAL scoring
- [Neo4j Setup](https://github.com/mrcyberharsh/pulse-infragraph#optional-neo4j): Graph persistence
- [Export Formats](https://github.com/mrcyberharsh/pulse-infragraph#export-formats): JSON, CSV, TXT, SARIF, PDF

## Use Cases

- Passive subdomain discovery for an authorized domain
- HTTP technology fingerprinting and risk triage
- Security header and TLS hygiene checks on discovered hosts

## Limitations

- Passive discovery only (certificate transparency)
- Heuristic risk scores are indicators, not proof
- Authorized domains only
